title: Rabbi Yohanan ben Arza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman places him in the first generation of the Amoraim of Eretz Yisrael, as in Avodah Zarah 58a: Once he sat down to drink wine with Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai. A certain man came, and they said to him, "Come, pour for us to drink." After he had poured the cup, it came to light that he was an idolater. One prohibited it even for benefit, and one permitted it even for drinking. Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said: The one who prohibited it prohibited properly, etc. And it is known that Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi was among the Amoraim of the first generation.
